items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there is a trumpet player Guerido Elarvarde, he still play for years at the Tropicana just for food.

ctx.x: For meals, yea. The food situation in the country was horrible in those days. (About the same as right now) So, and still today there is a trumpet player Guerido Elarvarde, he still play for years at the Tropicana just for food. At night, he go play the show, for the food. So, I play that and I conduct the Benny More—Benny was dead for several years—the Benny More orchestra used to accompany the show in Tropicana for a whole month. So, a friend of mine Marcus, he used to play the lead and conduct, it was very,…
So, this was around 1971-73, around there?
